title: Railway service settings (ADR-0008)
description: Declarative settings of one Railway service. deploy-images.mjs applies them with serviceInstanceUpdate before each deploy and fails when Railway reports different values.

service.description: Name of the service in the Railway project (and of this file).

image.description: Release image whose digest is deployed: the service reads image-<image>.txt from the GitHub release (ops runs migrate and backup).

startCommand.description: Start command (replaces the image CMD); null keeps the image default. The images have no pnpm/npm, so it is a plain node line.

healthcheck.description: HTTP health check Railway gates the deployment on; null when the service has none (clamav listens on TCP only, backup is a cron job).

cronSchedule.description: Five-field cron expression in UTC; null for services that run continuously.
